newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman bearish on Rolls-Royce.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman bearish on Rolls-Royce.

text.p: Shares in Rolls-Royce were cut to "underperform' in a research note from analysts at Lehman Brothers on Tuesday, which recommended selling the shares at current levels.
The shares were down 3p to 255p by 1030 GMT in a generally weaker stock market. Analysts at the brokerage have a price target of between 205-230p for the stock.
The research note said that relative to its peers the stock is looking fully valued. It added that recent alliances in the industry now make a similar link-up for Rolls Royce less likely.
